title: Controlled six-utterance readback capture
summary: A model told only 'Say Alpha' can improvise to fill its render duration. Generate fixed groups of six prescribed utterances instead and require silence once the final item is spoken.
invariants: Reference calibration: 'Alpha. ten. A. Bravo. Charlie. oh.'
Instruction: say exactly the listed items, in order, without greetings, explanations or other spoken words; remain silent afterwards.
Pronunciation 'oh' is intentionally distinct from zero; 10 is pronounced ten; source ICAO spellings Alfa and Juliett remain in the vocabulary.
12 planned captures per character times six characters equals 72 planned captures, not 72 rendered videos.
An exact transcript produces pending human review, never automatic approval.
When generation still improvises, a controlled speech-and-mouth pipeline is preferable to accepting invented words.
procedure: Use the readback generator for deterministic prompts.
Bind each prompt to explicit character reference and requested utterances.
Normalize the independent transcript with narrow pronunciation aliases.
Reject missing, reordered, additional or ambiguous speech where reliable evidence is absent.
Publish only after authorised listening and source-PTS-aligned visual confirmation.

provenance.claim: Readback six-utterance generation plan, script matching and review limits.
